notes:
Lead background:
- SMB (SaaS) focused on mid-market help desks; chatbot + agent assist primary product.
- 60 product seats, 5M monthly API calls expected in 12-18 months if POC successful (growth projection).

Primary asks/questions from discovery call:
- 'Which model should we use for chat UI vs embedding search?' (they explicitly asked about Llama, Mistral, Qwen).
- They want to understand quality vs cost tradeoffs: e.g., is llama-2-13b noticeably better at policy-sensitive summarization than mistral-xl-7b for our prompts? Will qwen variants be cheaper with equivalent quality?
- Concerned about hallucinations on policy/legal document summaries and need reproducible outputs for audit.

Technical constraints & targets:
- Deployment: hosted_api (public cloud). No on-prem now.
- Security: must support SSO/SAML, SOC2 attestation, audit logs retention (90 days).
- Latency target: p95 <= 250ms ideal for chat UI; willing to accept up to 400ms during peak.
- Throughput: bursty traffic; average concurrent users 300, peak concurrent messages ~1200/min.
- Cost sensitivity: high; target <$0.001 per user-query on average. Interested in quantized model options and token-level batching to reduce cost.

Model selection notes from call (SE + customer):
- Llama-2-13b: customer expects stronger instruction-following and fewer hallucinations on internal docs; cost higher vs 7B class models but may reduce post-edit work.
- Mistral-xl-7b: attractive cost/latency profile; curious about quality on multi-paragraph summarization and safety.
- Qwen-7b & qwen-chat: interested in Qwen as a lower-cost baseline with good conversational behavior; wants examples.
- Asked about Redwood's verified performance profiles and if there are canned evals comparing those specific variants on summarization/hallucination metrics.
- SE suggested running side-by-side POC using the hosted API: same prompt set, measure p95 latency, token cost, ROUGE/BLEU-ish metrics + manual hallucination scoring on 50 policy docs.

POC scope agreed informally:
- 2 week POC using hosted_api credits.
- Run 3 models: llama-2-13b (or 13B q4 quantized), mistral-xl-7b, qwen-7b/chat.
- Measurements: latency (p50/p95), avg cost per interaction, hallucination rate (manual sampling), quality score on summarization and QA.
- Integrate prefix caching for doc-search to evaluate cache hit improvement.

Risks called out by customer:
- "If hosted latency is too variable we may not be able to ship chat UI".
- Budget: "we need to see cost projections for projected scale".
- Compliance: "need SOC2 proof and SAML handshake example before procurement".
